findings.title: Measured overstepping takes the shape of overflow
findings.claim: The focus verb's moral overstepping is also pictured as force rising past a measured boundary, so a created capacity appears in the form of overflow.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier يَطْغَىٰٓ is read through the limit facet and the overflow facet; the independent balance warning in 55:8 and overflowing water in 69:11 bring the two facets into contact, changing an abstract moral label into a breach with physical pressure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the human breach as both a violation of measure and a force that presses beyond its channel.
findings.containment: The human subject and moral reading remain primary. The water scene supplies an image of overflow, not a literal flood event in 96:6 and not a claim that every use of the word is physical.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch pairing and trusted publication are explicit, while the connection rows supply exact target Arabic but not target morphology; the physical contact is therefore retained with a stated boundary.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlığın kendisi için geçerli sınırı veya uygun ölçüyü aşması çekirdek anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus imperfect verb yaṭghā carries the ordinary relation of a subject crossing a valid limit or measure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 55:8 connection supplies the independent balance and measure prohibition, with exact target Arabic for not crossing in the balance.
branch_activations.activation: The balance as a measured order makes the focus verb's moral crossing a breach of an intelligible limit rather than a free-floating intensity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus diagnosis acquires a measured-boundary image: the human oversteps an order that can be weighed.
branch_activations.boundary: The trigger establishes the limit image; it does not turn the focus into a legal reading of the external ayah or select a different subject.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Su veya sel, olağan miktarı ve düzeyi aşacak ölçüde çoğalır ve yükselir.
branch_activations.carrier: The same focus verb carries the supplied surge facet alongside its local human subject.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 69:11 connection supplies water that has crossed its ordinary level and carried people.
branch_activations.activation: The external water scene gives the focus verb an independent nonhuman carrier-image; meeting the focus verb makes moral overstepping legible as swelling force.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The human's overstepping can be felt as capacity swelling beyond its channel and pressing past its measure.
branch_activations.boundary: The water is an activating image for the moral verb, not a literal second subject or a claim that 96:6 narrates the flood.

findings.title: Overstepping hardens into rival command
findings.claim: The focus's transgression is also opened into a social power that can redirect or obstruct another's worship, allowing excess to harden into rival authority.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb carries the ordinary limit-crossing facet, while the public transgression in 89:11 and the taghut authority term in 39:17 independently give that crossing a social body; their contact changes private excess into a power that can stand over another's devotion.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the warning as reaching beyond inner pride toward the moment when a person's excess becomes a command over someone else's worship.
findings.containment: This retains a social authority resonance without naming one historical person, making the focus itself a technical taghut definition, or replacing the general human diagnosis with a single political case.

epistemic.reason: A trusted focus-anchored publication supplies the changed reading and legacy walk records preserve the social consequence; the external connection rows provide exact Arabic surfaces but no target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlığın kendisi için geçerli sınırı veya uygun ölçüyü aşması çekirdek anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries the ordinary act of crossing a valid limit.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 89:11 connection supplies public plural transgression in the lands, giving limit-crossing a collective power setting.
branch_activations.activation: Public transgression makes the focus's general overstepping legible as an exercised social force rather than an inward attitude alone.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The human who oversteps can appear as a public actor whose excess reaches other people.
branch_activations.boundary: The public setting is a contextual extension, not a claim that the focus names a particular regime or historical group.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yanlış yolun önderi, tapınılan sahte varlık veya saptırıcı zorba güç
branch_activations.facet_statement: Yanlış yola önderlik eden ve başkalarını iyilik yolundan çeviren kişi, varlık veya güç temel kategoriyi oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus's overstepping verb is the carrier, with the authority facet supplied as an extension of what overstepping can do to another person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 39:17 connection supplies the exact taghut authority term in a context of worship and turning toward Allah.
branch_activations.activation: The authority term gives the focus's crossing a social direction: excess becomes the power that can mislead or claim control over another's worship.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The diagnosis opens onto rival command, where overstepping is no longer only excess but a competing direction for obedience.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus is not being declared a lexical taghut noun; the supplied authority category is an attributed contextual resonance of its verb.

findings.title: Visible humanity can conceal dependence
findings.claim: The generic human noun can carry a visible social human whose prominence sits over an origin of dependence, so visibility may become the occasion for forgetting attachment.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ names the human species or its member; the independent human-need statement in 35:15 and non-abandonment question in 75:36 return to that human carrier, changing a generic reference into a visible yet dependent agent.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the named human is not merely present in the scene: public visibility can make dependence easier to overlook.
findings.containment: The finding concerns a possible relation between social visibility and forgotten dependence. It does not make visibility the definition of the human noun, assert that every visible person forgets dependence, or state a surah-wide thesis.

epistemic.reason: The publication supplies a trusted focus anchor and the reader walk supplies the same relation with legacy qualification; the two external rows provide exact context surfaces without complete target morphology.

branch_activations.carrier: The definite human noun names the human kind or one member of it at the focus surface.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 35:15 connection places human beings as needy before the self-sufficient God, supplying an independent dependence frame.
branch_activations.activation: The dependence frame meets the focus's generic human noun and makes visible human presence carry the tension between social appearance and conditioned existence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The named human can be seen as conspicuous in the world while still standing inside a relation of need.
branch_activations.boundary: The visibility pressure is an attributed contextual effect; it does not redefine the noun as a word for sight or forgetfulness.

findings.title: The corrective opening turns received measure into reversal
findings.claim: The corrective kallā makes the named human the point where the received creation-and-teaching sequence turns into overstepping beyond measure.
findings.mechanism: The focus's opening interruption halts the prior movement, while the focus human noun and verb meet external creation in 32:7, measured order in 55:8, and overflowing water in 69:11; the contact makes the sequence readable as a reversal from received formation to de-calibration.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the opening correction as a turn in direction: what was received and formed is now shown crossing its measure.
findings.containment: The reversal is an abductive relation preserved from the reader walk, not a statement that teaching mechanically causes rebellion. The omitted authority branch and unresolved root citations remain outside this bounded finding.

epistemic.reason: The source explicitly marks the causal arrow as abductive; exact focus branches and external Arabic connection surfaces support the reversal image, while target morphology remains unsupplied.

findings.title: Self-sufficiency turns received capacity into overflow
findings.claim: When human capacity received through creation and teaching is taken as self-sufficient, the focus's overstepping can be heard as that capacity spilling beyond its measure.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb carries the limit and overflow facets; the exact self-sufficiency term in 80:5 triggers the inward premise, while overflowing water in 69:11 triggers the outward image, so the focus gains a causal transition from presumed independence to force beyond its channel.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the overflow as a change in how received capacity is held: what was given becomes dangerous when it is treated as self-owned.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory causal reading of the supplied sequence. It does not say that teaching necessarily causes rebellion, collapse the moral reading into water, or claim that every abundance produces transgression.

epistemic.reason: The wide reader walk states the self-sufficiency-to-overflow relation as an inference, and the exact connection rows supply the two independent trigger surfaces without full target morphology.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus overstepping becomes the outward behavior of capacity held as self-sufficient.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection supplies a parallel posture, not a claim that 80:5 is the grammatical context of 96:6.

branch_activations.boundary: The physical water remains an analogy and does not replace the human moral subject or assert a literal flood in the focus.
